title: The Stinson Missile Crisis
cn: 第 4 集 · 斯廷森导弹危机
novel: Robin [[attacked|attack]] a girl who tried to ruin Barney's [[relationship|relationship]] with Nora. Her anger got her into [[trouble|trouble]], and she was forced to go to therapy. She sat in the therapist's office and felt [[reluctant|reluctant]] to talk about her feelings. The therapist asked her many questions, but Robin tried to [[avoid|avoid]] answering them honestly. She [[pretended|pretend]] that everything was fine, but deep down she knew it was not. Meanwhile, Ted got too [[involved|involve]] in Lily's [[pregnancy|pregnancy]]. He tried to help with every detail, from buying baby clothes to [[decorating|decorate]] the nursery. Lily [[appreciated|appreciate]] his help but also felt a bit [[overwhelmed|overwhelm]] by his enthusiasm. Ted read many books about babies and [[pregnancy|pregnancy]]. He wanted to be the best friend possible to Marshall and Lily. Marshall found Ted's behavior both [[touching|touching]] and slightly [[unusual|unusual]]. Robin finally [[opened|open]] up to her therapist about why she hit the girl. She [[admitted|admit]] that she still had [[feelings|feeling]] for Barney. The therapist [[suggested|suggest]] that Robin needed to face her emotions. Robin [[realized|realize]] that running away from her feelings would not help her. She decided to be more honest with herself and the people around her.

attack.en: to use physical force against someone

pretend.en: to act as if something is true

suggest.en: to propose an idea for someone
